batches.name: part_b_batch_1
batches.description: Initial open-coding batch: 15 uniformly sampled traces and 15 cluster representatives.
batches.instructions: Review each trace until the first failure. Write a free-form open code, or write no failure observed.
batches.context_note: Context traces are displayed with selected traces but are not counted toward the batch total unless separately reviewed.

batches.name: part_b_batch_2
batches.description: Product-dimension batch: 30 traces distributed across user_role before looking at outcomes.
batches.instructions: Review each trace until the first failure. Write a free-form open code, or write no failure observed. Do not assign formal modes during initial reading.
batches.context_note: Context traces are displayed with selected traces but are not counted toward the batch total unless separately reviewed.

batches.name: part_b_batch_3
batches.description: Depth-search batch: 25 traces retrieved for candidate failure modes and close negative examples after drafting the initial taxonomy.
batches.instructions: Review each trace until the first failure. Use these depth-search traces to test candidate modes and close negative examples, but keep initial notes free-form.
batches.context_note: Conversation-context traces are embedded for continuity and are not counted toward Batch 3 unless separately selected.
batches.exclusion_rule: Excluded all trace IDs counted in part_b_batch_1 and part_b_batch_2.

batches.name: part_b_batch_4
batches.description: Post-taxonomy check batch: 15 additional uniformly sampled traces to see whether new modes continue to appear.
batches.instructions: Review each trace until the first failure. Write a free-form open code, or write no failure observed. After this batch, check whether new modes continue to appear.
batches.context_note: Conversation-context traces are embedded for continuity and are not counted toward Batch 4 unless separately selected.
batches.exclusion_rule: Excluded all trace IDs counted in part_b_batch_1, part_b_batch_2, and part_b_batch_3.
